lines.en: I crawl through the rock crevice step by step.

lines.zh: 这么多腿，走起来沙沙响。
lines.en: So many legs. I rustle as I walk.
The cave is dark. I can't see the way.
I edge along the rock wall.
Stalagmites drip above me.
This moss is easy to walk on.
I duck under a stone.
I walk slowly, afraid of being stepped on.
I crawl deeper into the dark caves.
The floor is wet and my feet stick.
I go around a patch of glowing moss.
I squeeze between the stones.
My antennae feel the way.

lines.zh: 我一蜷起来，护甲就有十五。
lines.en: Curl me up and my armor hits fifteen.
I climb onto a higher stone ledge.
This rock face is long.
I stay curled in the crevice.
This is safest.
My shell is flush with the stone.
The dripping is quite regular.
I tuck my legs in a little.
Is someone nearby?

lines.zh: 洞里滴水，我跟着数节拍。
lines.en: Water drips in the cave; I count the beat.
Under the stone is cool.
I'm not planning to go out.
This cave is quiet.

lines.zh: 一卷起来，护甲就到十五。
lines.en: Curled up, my armor hits fifteen.
The dark suits me best.
You have crouched down to look at me.
Don't poke me with a finger.
I'm only a pillbug.
Your face is blocking the light.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我把壳缝对住你。
lines.en: You crouch, and I turn my shell seam toward you.
Are you going to step on me?

lines.zh: 我身上有节，一节一节的。
lines.en: My body is segmented, plate after plate.
This isn't your place.
I look up at you. Very small.
Stay still, and I'll come out.
I've curled up!
My shell got knocked.
It hurts. My legs went stiff.
Don't knock on my shell.
I rolled to the stone's edge.
I'm actually still alive.
I've marked this on my shell.
One of my seams cracked.
I'm crawling slower now.
You shouldn't have stepped on me.
I curl up and my shell is harder than stone.
Is that rotting leaves?

lines.zh: 这片腐叶够我啃一整天。
lines.en: This rotten leaf will keep me chewing all day.
Put it on the ground. Take it slow.
You're so tall. I can't reach.
A few crumbs are enough for me.
I smell fungus.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我才敢伸出触角。
lines.en: Step back half a pace, then I dare extend my antennae.
Is this for me?
The smell is close and far at once.
Your boot touched my shell.

lines.zh: 我卷成一颗小石子，不吭声。
lines.en: I roll into a pebble and stay silent.
I rolled once and hit a stone.
Don't push me. I roll.
I'm stuck in the crevice.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底阴影罩下来，我滚开。
lines.en: The shadow of your sole falls; I roll clear.
I bounced off and stopped.
Your boot fills the whole crevice.

lines.zh: 我滑了一下，壳擦过地面。
lines.en: I slipped and my shell scraped the floor.
Touch me and you'll feel how hard I am.
There's another one under the stone.
We come together slowly.
You're blocking the light.
Our shells touched.
It's safe here. Good for staying.
Don't lift the stone. We'll scatter.
I curl up, and so does she.

lines.zh: 过一阵，石缝里会多几只。
lines.en: Soon there'll be more in the crevice.

lines.zh: 缩成一颗球，就不用说话。
lines.en: Curl into a ball and no words are needed.
Just stay in the dark.
This rotten leaf is mine.
I drag it along, slowly.
Crumbs you dropped?
I haul it back to my crevice.
Is this stone? Can't bite it.
I crawl along pushing it.
I hide it under my shell.
A bit heavy. I'll take my time.

lines.zh: 一小块菌肉，我顶在背上。
lines.en: A small piece of mushroom flesh; I balance it on my back.
Watch all you like, I'm still hauling it.
Curl up, and my armor hits fifteen.
I brace my legs.
Food, or danger?

lines.zh: 我绕过一块碎石，接近你。
lines.en: I go around a rubble stone and close on you.
It's the smell of insects under rotten moss.
I keep close to the floor.

lines.zh: 别看我这样子，我卷起来很硬。
lines.en: Looks aside, I curl up hard.
I do have teeth.
You're the one who lifted the stone.
I've curled up.
Something in your hand is swaying.
I've crawled a little toward you.
I'm following that smell.
These crevices are hard to cross.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根，一节一节地量。
lines.en: I follow the wall base, measuring it segment by segment.
I've touched your shoe.
Don't move. I'm underneath.
I've gone around to your other side.
Step down and I'm gone.

lines.zh: 你每一步的落点，都震到我。
lines.en: Every place your foot lands jars me.
I know the ways of this cave.
You can't catch me.
You step back, and I follow.
I slip around along the wall base.
I pinched you.
My mouthparts are small but strong.
Your finger pulled back.

lines.zh: 一蜷起来，我硬得像颗石。
lines.en: Curled up, I'm hard as stone.
That's all I've got. I'm tired.
I shoved at your foot.
I made you itch.
I can't bite through your armor.
I pinched again.
I quickly pulled back.
I crawl out from under the stone.
The moss here just grew.

lines.zh: 蜷起来，我的护甲有十五点。
lines.en: Curled up, my armor hits fifteen.
The cave has one more of me.

lines.zh: 钟乳石洞里，我探出触角。
lines.en: In the stalactite cave, I poke out my antennae.

lines.zh: 我把十四节甲片一节节撑开。
lines.en: I spread my fourteen armor segments one by one.
The damp down here is just right.
I climb up the rock face.
Out of the dark, here I am.
I'll find a corner to settle in.
Fire heats my shell until it burns.

lines.zh: 从石台上掉下来，我滚了两圈。
lines.en: Off the ledge, I rolled twice.

lines.zh: 水滴把我淹了，我拼命划。
lines.en: A drop drowned me. I paddled hard.
A boom flipped me over.
A pebble struck my shell.

lines.zh: 咒语打过来，我整只都僵了。
lines.en: The spell hit and I went rigid.

lines.zh: 洞里什么都没有，我饿瘦了。
lines.en: Nothing in the cave. I'm wasting away.
Thunder rolls through the cave. I tremble.
It's too deep below. I don't dare look.
